import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    parts = line.split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1])
    
    coeffs = [0] * 32
    for i in range(30):
        coeffs[i] = m % n
        m //= n
    
    feasible = True
    for i in range(30):
        c = coeffs[i]
        if c == 0 or c == 1:
            continue
        if c == n or c == n - 1:
            coeffs[i + 1] += 1
        else:
            feasible = False
            break
    
    print("YES" if feasible else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
